sections.heading: Role Summary
sections.body: Lead Frontend Engineer at Stickman Cyber since May 2024, working remotely. Architects the frontend and leads the team for an automated AI-assisted cybersecurity platform.

sections.heading: Responsibilities

sections.heading: Key Achievements

Improved backend performance using Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Redis caching, and SQL query optimization.
